$comment: Rules for the component parity check (scripts/parity.mjs). Code leads for components: Figma must mirror these props. Every exception here must also be listed in GAPS.md.

codeOnlyComponents.Stack: Figma has no Stack component: use an auto layout frame with the gap bound to space/compact|default|section.
codeOnlyComponents.Cluster: Figma has no Cluster component: use a horizontal, wrapping, centred auto layout frame with the gap bound to a space token.
codeOnlyComponents.Text: Figma uses text styles, not a component. Each Text variant is a text style of the same name.

codeOnlyProps.as: Which HTML element renders (section, ul, h2). Semantics only; nothing to show in Figma.
codeOnlyProps.type: Button's HTML type (button, submit). Behaviour only.
